title: Should the import-hold fence-owner proof consult ResponsibilityEntry records and the fence owner's coverage, not only enrolled Exact bindings?
outcome: The import-reconciliation design owner decides whether engram_import_fence_owner_is_another must also consult ResponsibilityEntry records, which carry their own owner_id and original_binding (for example HistoricOwner or RetainedHead), and/or the fence owner's coverage and association, when proving that an owner-scoped fence does not cover a candidate. If it should, a follow-up implements it.
acceptance: The import-reconciliation design owner records a decision on this item: either owner-record bindings suffice as proof, or which ResponsibilityEntry kinds and which owner coverage or association states must also be consulted
if the decision requires a change, a follow-up item is filed and linked here
